title: One compactification model for localizing lower-shriek composition
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a positive-characteristic field $k$ of characteristic different from $\ell$, separated finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y,Z$, and separated finite-type $k$-maps $X\xrightarrow fY\xrightarrow gZ$. Let $E$ be a finite subextension of $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ and let $\Lambda$ be isomorphic as a condensed ring to $E$ or to the finite-subextension-valued condensed algebraic closure [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. Using the ordinary unbounded module-object derived category and the localizing closure [sk-def-localizing-closure], there exist boundary compactifications $c_f,c_g,c_{gf}$ [sk-def-nagata-sketch-data] and a natural isomorphism $R^{c_g}g_!R^{c_f}f_!\simeq R^{c_{gf}}(gf)_!$ on $\operatorname{Loc}(\mathcal D_{ctf}(X,\Lambda))$, with ambient derived target. No compatibility between compactification choices is asserted.

source.place: Proposition sk-thm-sf-comp-composition, clause (1), rational coefficient cases; proof file sk-thm-sf-comp-composition.proof.md, “The composition isomorphism” and compactification-independence in “Canonicity and associativity”.

proof.text: Choose dense compactifications f=jp and g=iq, and a dense compactification pi=ur. The composite open ju and proper map rq give the third compactification.

Open preservation puts j!K in the required closure. Proper/open interchange supplies unique normalized components on all unbounded inputs and makes them invertible on this closure. Write normalization as U(m)b=a using the invertible open unit. To cancel equal normalized restrictions of maps F(A) to G(B), put their difference in the off-diagonal block of A ⊞ B. Adding it to the unique normalized map at A ⊞ B preserves normalization, so uniqueness makes the block zero; the two projections recover equality of the original arrows. Naturality of a and b therefore proves naturality of the chosen interchange components.
Push the interchange isomorphism forward by Rq*. Compose the open-extension and derived direct-image comparisons to obtain the asserted isomorphism for this one triple.

proof_origin.place: The composition isomorphism: Nagata compactifications, proper/open interchange, and composition of the open and proper functors; no auxiliary-choice comparison is asserted.

theorem exists_localizingLowerShriekComposition_model
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (_hΛ : Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E)) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ)))
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Z.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [g.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g] :
    ∃ (cf : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification f)
      (cg : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification g)
      (cgf : Compactification.BoundaryCompactification (f ≫ g)),
      Nonempty (((localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).ι ⋙
          rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ cf.obj.obj ⋙
          rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification Λ cg.obj.obj) ≅
        compactificationLocalizingCandidate Λ cgf)
